observedProblem: R05 permits as many as 1024 simultaneous WebView2-to-native consent/route requests; this may queue overlapping native dialogs and operations. At the 1024-request document quota, replaying a previously admitted requestId receives a new contradictory HOLD reply, rather than being silently suppressed. The original C09 source test also contained three obsolete R01 signatures incompatible with the correct R05 per-request cancellation token.
actualFix: Added separate 8-in-flight native backpressure gate before requestId reservation/token creation; a busy request is not marked seen and receives P01_NATIVE_BUSY/HOLD for safe retry. Duplicate requestIds now return before quota rejection, avoiding contradictory terminal status. Updated three obsolete source regression expectations while preserving original test and existing host. Native consent, route tokens, HOME/MENU/CORE, origin gate, event revocation and post-ACK checks are kept.
